reviews.text: Nice variety of treats for ur pets.

Visited on May 31, 2026. 1016 days remaining.

It was a pet supply store that mainly sold dog food and goods. I had finished running errands at another store on the same floor and was about to go down when I got lost. I was wandering around in circles when this store caught my eye, and I decided to take a look.

They seemed to only carry natural pet food, and among the goods, I found a 3D face magnet that looked exactly like a cat owned by an acquaintance, so I bought it. Because of my ridiculously lingering feelings from a broken heart, I've been making some rather unusual requests, so I wanted to give them something as a thank you. I hope they like it.

It seemed to be a popular shop and was bustling with customers.

The staff were cheerful and friendly.

The day after my visit, when I mentioned that I was getting another puppy, they helped me choose a sample of puppy food.

My older dog seemed happy when I gave him some healthy-looking rice with furikake (rice seasoning)!

Apparently, you can also order online through their member website.

I stop by here whenever I come to Matsuya, or maybe I come here mainly for that reason (lol). The ladies there are all very kind and willing to help with any questions you may have. I'll definitely be back!
Healthy treat and food for dogs

First visit, 7th floor store
Children are allowed in if they are in a shopping cart
Sampling is available, so picky eaters can consult before buying.

A wide variety of products are lined up in the small store.
Mostly familiar products, making it feel safe and trustworthy.
There were a few products I didn't know about, which was exciting. I enjoyed getting advice!

No live animal sales!

No suspicious food!

Only human-grade, safe food is sold!

I feel safe spending money in a clean business that doesn't engage in live animal sales.

I sincerely hope that companies that participate in evil practices will be eradicated so that no more unfortunate animals are created, and that only stores like this will survive.

The small store was filled with many parents thinking of their children. It made me happy.
